items.title: DOJ says Hamas crypto seizures reached $560,000 as FBI took over fundraising sites
items.description: FBI agents took control of domains and servers, specifically Alqassam.ps, to intercept donations and prevent further fundraising for the Al-Qassam Brigades.

items.title: Kraken parent Payward delays IPO to second quarter of 2027 at earliest
items.description: The crypto exchange operator, which confidentially filed for a U.S. listing last November, had already put its IPO plans on hold amid difficult market conditions.

items.title: Crypto made new friends in U.S. primaries, but focus now shifts to general election
items.description: Adding Massachusetts incumbent Auchincloss to the list of winning primary candidates Fairshake supported, the industry's influence moves on to November.

items.title: New Jersey becomes first state to ask Supreme Court to weigh in on prediction markets
items.description: After multiple appeals courts ruled differently about whether states can crack down on prediction markets' sports products, New Jersey asked SCOTUS to step in.

items.title: Crypto Long & Short: Crypto VCs are mistaking consensus for discipline
items.description: In this week's Crypto Long & Short, Varun Datta of Truth Ventures writes that crypto venture capital's retreat to later-stage deals is a consensus trade dressed as discipline. With proven companies taking 57% of last quarter's capital, he argues the founding-stage gap is where the returns are, and lays out three things to look for.

items.title: CrowdStrike and federal authorities dismantle Russian malware that secretly stole crypto for 8 years
items.description: Russia-based Sality watched for copied bitcoin and Ethereum addresses and quietly replaced them with the attacker’s. CrowdStrike and law enforcement have now isolated more than 15,000 infected machines.

items.title: The token supercycle: everything of value is becoming programmable
items.description: Tokenization is not just about increasing access to tokens, whatever they may represent, but a fundamental shift in how value is created, owned, financed and moved, argues Solana Foundation’s Lily Liu.

items.title: The bearish 'Bart Simpson' pattern is back as bitcoin and XRP prices pull back
items.description: Analysts discuss the cartoon-themed price action as prices for major cryptocurrencies wilt.

items.title: US officials work with CrowdStrike to fight malware behind crypto theft
items.description: Federal authorities and private-sector partners were part of an operation to disrupt malware that redirected about $150,000 in crypto over the last eight years.

items.title: Coinbase launches regulated crypto derivatives in Canada
items.description: Coinbase is offering eligible Canadian traders perpetual and dated futures with up to 10x leverage as major US trading platforms expand their crypto presence in Canada.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today

items.title: New Jersey officials petition US Supreme Court over prediction markets

items.title: Wyoming adds Chainlink reserve verification to state-issued stable token
items.description: Wyoming is using Chainlink to bring near-real-time reserve verification onchain for FRNT as the oracle provider expands its footprint across tokenized financial markets.

items.title: Ondo urges SEC, CFTC to bring US stock perpetuals onshore
items.description: Ondo says existing US securities laws can accommodate perpetual futures tied to individual stocks as regulators look to bring more derivatives activity onshore.

items.title: Bitcoin’s apparent demand turns negative as price struggles with $77K
items.description: One of Bitcoin’s onchain demand indicators turns negative again after a brief August rebound, as BTC price slipped below $77,000 amid a broader bond and equities sell-off.

items.title: G20 members tout ‘clear pathways’ for digital asset innovation
items.description: Officials in the G20, under the US’ presidency, recognized that digital assets could support “broad-based economic growth” and called for improvements in cross-border transactions.

items.title: Iran attacks Kuwait as Trump says renewed Mideast hostilities will not last 'too long'
items.description: On Thursday, Kuwait's army said it was confronting hostile missile and drone attacks from Iran.

items.description: Broadcom gave a disappointing revenue forecast for the current quarter but provided robust earnings guidance for fiscal 2028.

items.title: Microsoft to start disclosing Azure quarterly revenue as company consolidates business units
items.description: Microsoft will begin reporting quarterly Azure revenue in dollars for the first time, providing more clarity about its business that competes with AWS.

items.title: NBA suspends Clippers owner Ballmer for one year in Kawhi Leonard salary cap probe
items.description: The NBA also fined the Los Angeles Clippers $30 million and said the team will forfeit five first-round picks, one in each year in drafts starting in 2029.

Could not retrieve a transcript for the video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kAcFiHtTDDg! This is most likely caused by:

YouTube is blocking requests from your IP. This usually is due to one of the following reasons:
- You have done too many requests and your IP has been blocked by YouTube
- You are doing requests from an IP belonging to a cloud provider (like AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Azure, etc.). Unfortunately, most IPs from cloud providers are blocked by YouTube.

There are two things you can do to work around this:
1. Use proxies to hide your IP address, as explained in the "Working around IP bans" section of the README (https://github.com/jdepoix/youtube-transcript-api?tab=readme-ov-file#working-around-ip-bans-requestblocked-or-ipblocked-exception).
2. (NOT RECOMMENDED) If you authenticate your requests using cookies, you will be able to continue doing requests for a while. However, YouTube will eventually permanently ban the account that you have used to authenticate with! So only do this if you don't mind your account being banned!

If you are sure that the described cause is not responsible for this error and that a transcript should be retrievable, please create an issue at https://github.com/jdepoix/youtube-transcript-api/issues. Please add which version of youtube_transcript_api you are using and provide the information needed to replicate the error. Also make sure that there are no open issues which already describe your problem!
